description: Reads one webinar by its id: title, type, status, host, start date, page address, and whether the emails are already written. Take it after the list, when the host picked one, for example "Tell me about the Tuesday one." It needs the session id and the id from wi_list_webinars, and that id is never invented. It reads only from the connected site and changes nothing. Without an open connection it says how to connect and returns no data. Read-only, it changes nothing. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers. Words hosts use: one webinar, details, Tuesday one, campaign

id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

name: wi_get_webinar
title: Read one webinar
